title: Track Lead - Incident Management, ServiceNow
description:
Track Lead \- Incident Management, ServiceNow
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Tools \& Automation Engineer plays a crucial role in enhancing operational efficiency through the development and maintenance of automation tools. This position focuses on asset management and ITIL processes, ensuring that all solutions align with organizational standards for quality and cost. The engineer will work collaboratively to deliver high\-quality code and support existing projects while responding to client requests.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Enhance Operational Systems By Implementing Itil Best Practices And Leveraging Tools Like Snow Admin And Bmc Remedy To Improve Management Reporting And Streamline Information Flow.
  

2\. Analyze Client Requirements And Ensure That The Support Team Consistently Meets Or Exceeds Client Expectations Through Proactive Incident Management And Effective Use Of Ca Service Desk.
  

3\. Lead And Mentor The Project Team, Fostering Transparent Communication Of Project Goals And Objectives While Promoting Collaboration And Accountability Within The Team.
  

4\. Innovate Process Development By Introducing New Ideas And Methodologies In Incident Management, Driving Overall Organizational Progress And Efficiency.
  

5\. Provide Tailored Solutions To Meet Customer Needs Through Comprehensive Understanding Of Incident Management Workflows And Effective Utilization Of Automation Tools To Achieve Business Results.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Strong Understanding Of Incident Management Principles And Itil Framework
  

2\. Proficient In Tools Such As Servicenow, Bmc Remedy, And Ca Service Desk
  

3\. Excellent Problem\-Solving Skills And Ability To Drive Operational Improvements
  

4\. Strong Leadership Capabilities With Experience In Team Management And Communication  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Itil Foundation Certification (Recommended)
  

2\. Servicenow Administrator Certification (Optional But Valuable)
  

3\. Bmc Remedy Certification (Optional But Valuable

title: SME - MS System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
description:
SME \- MS System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


As a Subject Matter Expert in Support and Operations, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the timely resolution of escalated incidents through thorough analysis and adherence to service level agreements (SLAs). Your expertise in SCCM will contribute to maintaining high\-quality standards while enhancing customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem\-solving.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Ensure On\-Time Resolution And Quality Compliance Of Escalated Tickets And Incidents By Analyzing Issues Through Sccm, Adhering To Agreed Slas For Operational Excellence.
  

2\. Mentor Administrators And Team Members While Preparing Standard Operating Procedures (Sops) And Maintaining Effective Documentation, Fostering Knowledge Sharing And Communication Within The Team.
  

3\. Validate Change Order Implementation Plans And Human Error Compliance, Participating Actively In Capacity Planning Efforts To Optimize Resource Utilization.
  

4\. Facilitate Positive Customer Feedback And Satisfaction By Engaging In Customer Meetings To Understand And Address Any Operational Challenges They May Encounter.
  

5\. Validate Analyses Such As Root Cause Analysis And Trend Analysis Using Sccm Data, Preparing Reports To Present Performance Metrics And Insights To Key Business Stakeholders.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. In\-Depth Knowledge Of Sccm And Its Application In Support And Operations.
  

2\. Strong Analytical Skills For Incident Resolution And Performance Analysis.
  

3\. Excellent Communication And Presentation Skills For Stakeholder Engagement.
  

4\. Familiarity With Change Management Processes And Capacity Planning.  

  

  

**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Itil Foundation Certification Is Optional But Valuable

title: Front Desk Executive
description:
**Job Description – Front Desk Executive**

**Position:** Front Desk Executive  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Department:** Administration / Front Desk Executive  
**Location:** Vaishali  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a professional, well\-groomed, and customer\-oriented **Front Desk Executive** with experience in the **Real Estate industry**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the reception area, handling visitors and calls, coordinating with clients, and providing administrative support to ensure smooth day\-to\-day front\-office operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the front desk and reception area professionally.
* Greet and welcome clients, customers, visitors, and business associates.
* Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department.
* Coordinate with the **Sales, CRM, and Project/Site teams** for client requirements and appointments.
* Schedule and manage meetings, appointments, and site visits.
* Maintain visitor records, call logs, and other front\-office registers.
* Handle basic client follow\-ups and coordinate with the concerned sales/CRM executive.
* Maintain records of walk\-in clients and ensure proper lead information is captured.
* Assist the sales team in managing walk\-in customers and initial project inquiries.
* Coordinate refreshments and meeting arrangements for clients and visitors.
* Support administrative activities and other office coordination as required.
* Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.

**Real Estate\-Specific Responsibilities**

* Handle **walk\-in clients and property/project inquiries**.
* Record and maintain details of prospective customers and leads.
* Coordinate **site visit appointments** with the sales/site team.
* Provide basic information about ongoing projects, locations, amenities, and available services as instructed.
* Coordinate with the CRM/Sales team regarding client visits and follow\-ups.
* Maintain daily records of walk\-ins, calls, inquiries, and site visits.
* Assist in collecting and organizing basic customer documents when required.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and customer\-handling skills.
* Professional personality and presentable appearance.
* Basic knowledge of **real estate projects and customer handling**.
* Good coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Good Hindi and English communication skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Prior experience in **Real Estate / Property / Construction / Builder industry** will be preferred.

**Key Performance Areas (KRA)**

* Professional handling of visitors and clients.
* Call and visitor management.
* Walk\-in lead generation and accurate data recording.
* Client communication and follow\-up coordination.

Interested candidates, get in touch with Ms. Nisha at 9311128718 or nishatomar.radon@gmail.com

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
